typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		SRC_SYS_MEMBER_NBR as string,
		CLM_LINE_DIAG_CD as string,
		CLM_LINE_DIAG_CODESET_CD as string,
		CLM_STATEMENT_BEGIN_DT as timestamp,
		SRC_SYS_PROVIDER_NBR as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @COMPAREDATE DATETIME = DATEADD(month, - 6, GETDATE())  DECLARE @IDCD_IDs TABLE (IDCD_ID VARCHAR(10),CLM_LINE_DIAG_CODESET_CD VARCHAR(5)) INSERT INTO @IDCD_IDs (IDCD_ID,CLM_LINE_DIAG_CODESET_CD) SELECT DISTINCT IDCD.IDCD_ID,CASE WHEN IDCD.IDCD_TYPE = \'T\' THEN \'ICD10\' ELSE \'ICD9\' END FROM PDS_OB_CODES OC 	INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_IDCD_DIAG_CD IDCD ON OC.OB_CODES_CODE_VALUE = IDCD.IDCD_ID 		AND OC.OB_CODES_CODE_TYPE = \'DIAG\' 		AND ((IDCD.IDCD_TYPE = \'T\' AND OC.OB_CODES_CODESET_CD = \'ICD10\') OR (IDCD.IDCD_TYPE IN (\'I\',\' \') AND OC.OB_CODES_CODESET_CD = \'ICD9\'))  SELECT DISTINCT 	SBSB.SBSB_ID + \'00\' AS SRC_SYS_MEMBER_NBR,  	CLMD.IDCD_ID AS CLM_LINE_DIAG_CD,  	IDCD.CLM_LINE_DIAG_CODESET_CD,  	CLCL.CLCL_LOW_SVC_DT AS CLM_STATEMENT_BEGIN_DT,  	CLCL.PRPR_ID AS SRC_SYS_PROVIDER_NBR  FROM @IDCD_IDs IDCD 	INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_CLMD_DIAG CLMD ON CLMD.IDCD_ID = IDCD.IDCD_ID  		AND CLMD.LAST_MODIFIED_DTM > ? 	INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_CLCL_CLAIM CLCL ON CLMD.CLCL_ID = CLCL.CLCL_ID 		AND CLCL.CLCL_LOW_SVC_DT > DATEADD(month, - 6, GETDATE()) 	INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB ON CLCL.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ODWDiagData
ODWDiagData derive(CodeType = 'DIAG') ~> AddCodeType
AddCodeType derive(CodeType = CodeType) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODE_VALUE as string,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODESET_CD as string,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_MEMBERNUMBER as string,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODE_TYPE as string,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_PROVIDER_NBR as string,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODE_VALUE = CLM_LINE_DIAG_CD,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODESET_CD = CLM_LINE_DIAG_CODESET_CD,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_MEMBERNUMBER = SRC_SYS_MEMBER_NBR,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODE_TYPE = CodeType,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_PROVIDER_NBR = SRC_SYS_PROVIDER_NBR,
		OB_MEMBERCODES_CODE_DATE = CLM_STATEMENT_BEGIN_DT)) ~> PDSOBMEMBERCODESSTAGING
